source_priority.title: Saltonstall, Peterson, Soreng 2004 — Recognition of North American native Phragmites subsp. americanus
source_priority.pages: 2004 SIDA 21(2):683–692; PDF page index 4 shows table
source_priority.findings: Genetics-grouped means ± SE (mm): Gulf ligule .57±.04 (n14); Gulf lower glume 3.9±.1 (n15), upper 6.3±.1 (n15). Introduced .69±.03 / 3.4±.1 / 5.8±.2; native americanus 1.26±.04 / 4.6±.1 / 7.3±.2; all overlap and population means are not single-photo IDs.
source_priority.scientific_caution: Gulf and introduced not consistently distinguishable with reproductive measurements; larger native average not a universal definitive cutoff.
source_priority.image_license: Scientific comparison reference only; no original image reproduction grant verified

source_priority.title: Palmquist et al. 2026 — At the edge of change, Colorado River southwestern native persistence
source_priority.study_scope: 83 sites, Utah-Arizona Grand Canyon region, genetically tested native americanus and introduced australis. DOES NOT TEST GULF BERLANDIERI.
source_priority.findings: Hairy axillary buds, deep-red lower internodes and looseness of aging sheaths were more reliable than strict old-sheath retention count or single glume-length cutoffs in the southwestern study region. Strong geographical/species-coverage restrictions.
